measured_problem_statement.semantic_readability: 0.94-1.00 from approximately L6 onward on measured family
measured_problem_statement.carrier_binding_capacity: whitened HRR and bipolar MAP 1.0 through k=16
measured_problem_statement.interpretation: Target content-dependent semantic -> episode-local codebook -> symbol routing while preserving existing semantic readout, symbol writeout, and carrier binding functions.

findings: Measured blocker is contextual/dynamic binding rather than carrier algebra through k<=16.
0.3611 baseline symbol hit is not significantly above 1/3 chance at reported p≈0.4225.
Numerical claims stay scoped to the exact measured Qwen3.5-0.8B-derived snapshot.
Current generator realizes actual S3 class-symbol permutations and derives target from the realized prompt mapping.

Newest v2 template generator independently crosses all six codebook display orders (4 templates x 6 S3 mappings x 3 classes x 6 orders = 432 template rows), removing display-position as a simple shortcut.
Four structural semantic banks, direct/inverted polarity, codebook-order variation and exact class-symbol counterbalance are useful anti-shortcut primitives.
Generator is not yet a complete train/validation/holdout constructor because template and lexical banks are shared across split invocations.
HOLDOUT_TEMPLATE_LEAK: generate_rows() uses the same SEMANTIC_BANK and QUERY_TEMPLATES for TRAIN, VALIDATION and HOLDOUT, so direct holdout generation is not a frozen unseen-template family.
LEXICAL_FAMILY_LEAK: the same three lexical variants per semantic class/template can be reused across splits; family/provenance IDs alone do not prove lexical isolation.
METADATA_TARGET_LEAK_RISK: curriculum metadata contains base_semantic_class and target_semantic_class. Training projection must prove only prompt/target enter model training.
SCALING_MEMORIZATION_RISK: three lexical variants per class/template are sufficient for generator tests, not for 20k-50k scale-up.
V2_SCOPE_IS_TEMPLATE_ONLY: v2 correctly refuses training-ready status and requires a later evidence-bound materializer; this is a protection, not a remaining defect.
Current tests require all six S3 permutations in each atom-triplet/template/polarity group and equal class-symbol counts.
This establishes generator counterbalance, not unseen-permutation generalization. The acceptance meaning of unseen permutation must be preregistered separately from full-S3 generator coverage.
Final reports need uncertainty/significance and retention-damage bounds, not threshold accuracy alone.
load_atoms() trusts token_id/token_count fields from an external atom JSON; it does not itself bind exact tokenizer/model revision, ABI manifest hash, atom row, or manifest member hashes.
Production rows need a partition manifest from the 46 accepted orthogonalized atoms, explicitly excluding rejected atom 'or'.
Every realized row must bind source package/ABI manifest, exact model/tokenizer identity, generator version and atom-row identity before accepted-dataset credit.
Do not make semantic reading, L23 symbol writeout, or HRR/MAP carrier algebra primary relearning objectives because they are already measured present at stated scope.
Freeze pre-training baselines and require general language/code retention within the current <=2% degradation contract plus binder-specific preservation tests.
Single-symbol target and episode-local codebook fit the intended Xeno binder path.
Harness acceptance still needs exact ABI atom realization, typed semantic-decision -> codebook-lookup -> emitted-symbol trace fields, and post-training lesion/shuffle/rescue controls.
Output accuracy alone cannot establish Global J-Space causal control.
Keep the new generator/tests as the current donor rather than creating a duplicate binder generator.
Promote no synthetic row to canonical evidence-qualified dataset tokens yet.
Close split isolation and ABI provenance, then generate a small real-atom audited seed before scale-up.

counterhypotheses.claim: Post-training symbol accuracy may come from ordinary text-level codebook parsing rather than the intended internal J-Space binding circuit.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Same-model causal lesion/shuffle/rescue after training selectively disrupts and restores binding while semantic readability stays intact.

counterhypotheses.claim: High validation accuracy may reflect memorization of the small semantic/template bank rather than context-invariant binding.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: A frozen structurally novel, lexically disjoint template family remains >=0.90 without holdout-guided tuning.

counterhypotheses.claim: The model may learn symbol priors rather than the episode-local mapping.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Dedicated unseen-symbol atom partitions plus exact class-symbol counterbalance and mapping-shuffle tests preserve performance.

required_repairs.action: Version separate TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT template+lexical families; holdout must be absent from train and validation. Add a deterministic semantic-bearing lexical-family overlap linter with explicit protocol-token exemptions.

Materialize the verified 46-atom ABI into exact tokenizer-bound atom records with manifest/member hashes, row identity, token_id/token_count, and deterministic disjoint atom partitions for train/validation/holdout.
Add an executable projection test proving curriculum/audit metadata including target_semantic_class never enters model input; only intended prompt and target are trainable fields.

Preregister whether unseen-permutation means unseen S3 index, unseen exact class<->atom mapping instance, or unseen mapping over an unseen atom triple; make generator coverage and evaluation holdout rules non-contradictory.
After repairs 1-4, generate a small real-ABI seed, run candidate row gate + family/provenance linter + split/lexical/atom provenance checks, then swarm-review before 20k-50k scale-up.

training_examples_delta.reason: Canonical main moved during this trigger and already received a stronger context-binding generator plus tests; duplicate implementation was deliberately avoided.

research_return.new_finding: Current main now closes both causal S3 mapping and deterministic display-order shortcut at template-generator level. The frontier has moved to split-isolated materialization, exact ABI atom provenance, and a model-view projection fence.
research_return.architecture_implication: Training and harness must share a versioned atom-partition and episode-binding trace contract; otherwise a successful textual curriculum can still fail to instantiate or measure the intended Xeno/J-Space binder.
